y-m-69-08.material: Kwisithuba, umphezulu α ngumphezulu we-xy (z=0). Umgca ohambelana ne-α uthetha ukuba umgca awuyi kwi-α kwaye awudibani ne-α. U-Sujin uthe: “Imigca emibini ehambelana ne-α zombini zikufutshane nomphezulu ofanayo α, ngoko rhoqo ziyadibana okanye ziyahambelana.” Kwisithuba, imigca emibini engahambelaniyo kwaye engadibaniyo ithiwa isemgangathweni 'wokungahambelani nokungadibani'.
y-m-69-08.prereq.0: Iindawo zemigca emibini esithubeni (iyadibana, iyahambelana, okanye ayidibani yaye ayihambelani) nentsingiselo yomgca ohambelana neplani
y-m-69-08.prereq.1: Izinto ezisisiseko zee-coordinates zesithuba (x, y, z) nokubhala icala lomgca njenge-vector
y-m-69-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba imigca emibini ehambelana ne-α ekuphakameni okwahlukileyo, uze ucinge ukuba imigca emibini iyadibana na nokuba icala layo licalo.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba amacala emigca emibini kufuneka anxulumane njani ukuze imigca ihambelane.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.a: Ilunge. Zombini zihambelana ne-α, ngoko zidibana okanye ziyahambelana.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.a: Utshintshe "ihambelana neplani enye" yaba "imigca emibini ilele kwiplani enye". Imigca emibini ehambelanayo inokuba kwiziphakamo ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.b: Ayihlali injalo. Zikho iimeko apho azidibani yaye azihambelani.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.b: Ucinge ngeemeko esithubeni apho imigca emibini ingadibani kodwa ingahambelani.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.c: Ilunge. Esithubeni, imigca emibini kufuneka idibane okanye ihambelane.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.c: Uthwale amava akho eplani ngqo wawasa esithubeni. Esithubeni, zikho iimeko apho imigca emibini ingadibani yaye ingahambelani.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.d: Iplani ithathwa njengebanzi ngokungenasiphelo, kodwa ucinge ngobukhulu. Iindawo zeendawo azinanto yakwenza nobukhulu.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.explain: Ukuba imigca emibini ehambelana ne-α ikwiziphakamo ezahlukeneyo yaye inamacala ahlukeneyo, ikwindawo yokungadibani nokungahambelani. Yenza umzekelo onjalo wena ngezantsi uze uhlole.

y-m-69-08.s.s3.explain: Ukuba zikwicala elifanayo le-α kumgama ofanayo ukusuka ku-α, zombini zilele kwiplani z=h. (Ukuba zikumgama ofanayo kuphela ukusuka ku-α kodwa zikumacala achaseneyo e-α, umzekelo kwi-z=1 nakwi-z=−1, zinokungadibani nokungahambelani.) Imigca emibini edibanayo okanye ehambelanayo nayo ilele kwiplani enye. Ukuba imigca emibini ethe nkqo okanye ukuba i-engile phakathi kwazo imiselwe kunokwenzeka nakwimigca engadibani yaye ingahambelani, ngoko akuqinisekisi ukuba zilele kwiplani enye.
